name: East Ayrshire
title: East Ayrshire —
tagline: Kilmarnock, Mauchline and the hills where Burns farmed.
summary: East Ayrshire is inland Ayrshire, with Kilmarnock as its main town and Mauchline, where Burns lived and married Jean Armour.
The Kilmarnock Edition of Burns' poems was published here in 1786, and Dean Castle is a medieval stronghold in a country park.
